spec.scope: Generic crit rate (no 'normal attacks' scoping in prose) — critRatePct, not critRateNormalPct.
spec.durationSemantics: Wall-clock 45 sec (durationSec:45). With cd 40s this is near-permanent uptime ONLY on rotations she actually bursts; never durationShots.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (own burst: 'Activates when using Burst Skill') with escalating steps — NOT fullBurstEnter. Diverges hard in the control comp: helm is co-B3, so FB count > isabel burstCast count.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Keyed to fullBurstEnter — applies (and escalates the Marked Target counter) on EVERY team Full Burst including helm's rotations, over-crediting uptime and reaching stage 3 twice as fast.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Run controlComp('isabel', true). Count buffApply{stat:'critRatePct', value:6.26, target isabel}: must EQUAL the number of isabel burstCast events, and ZERO must land on FB rotations where only helm cast. Red under fullBurstEnter (count == FB count). Also assert expiresFrame−applyFrame ≈ 45×60.
spec.inertness: No critRatePct apply before her first burst; nothing applied to allies/helm.

spec.triggerIdentity: escalating step 2 on the same burstCast counter — 'Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it' means her 2nd burst applies step1 AND step2.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Escalation read as 'Nth use applies only the Nth effect' — 2nd burst gives crit damage but drops/never-refreshes the crit rate.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: On isabel's 2nd burstCast frame: BOTH buffApply critRatePct 6.26 AND critDamagePct 18.03 appear (refresh:true acceptable on the first). Red under only-Nth-step (critRatePct absent on cast 2).
spec.inertness: No critDamagePct before her 2nd burst (must not appear on cast 1 or on helm's casts).

spec.scope: Generic atkPct (target's own ATK; self-target so caster==target).
spec.triggerIdentity: escalating step 3, burstCast counter; 4th+ burst stays at stage 3 and re-applies all three (counter caps, does not wrap to 1).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Counter wraps after 3 (4th burst re-applies only step 1), or stage capped but only ATK re-applied on 4th+.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: On isabel's 3rd burstCast: buffApplies for critRatePct 6.26 + critDamagePct 18.03 + atkPct 17.28 all present. If the fight yields a 4th cast, the SAME three re-apply. Red under wrap (4th cast applies only 6.26) and under only-Nth.

spec.scope: Skill proc damage (flatDamage 170.58% of final ATK). Per rule 9: crits at her sheet rate, NO core, NO range bonus (engine force-sets no-range on riders), FB +50% by landing timing (default ON — no noFb evidence in prose).
spec.durationSemantics: Instant hit per proc; no duration.
spec.triggerIdentity: NO activation clause in the prose → interval trigger. The interval seconds is an ALWAYS-⚑ field (cadence tuple): NOT in the kit text — flag with estimate from datamined skillCooldownsSec, verify by popup-cadence count in footage. First-fire phase (t=sec, interval convention: no 'Forcefully uses' clause) also ⚑.
spec.targetSet: enemy — '5 enemy unit(s) with the highest final DEF' collapses to exactly ONE hit vs the single partless boss.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Two plausible misreads: (a) cadence tied to her firing (shotFired/lastBullet/hitCount) so the proc rate scales with SG reloads instead of wall-clock; (b) ×5 damage per proc from the 5-target clause.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Filter damage events with mult 170.58 / skill2 srcSlot: exactly ONE instance per proc (red under ×5), inter-proc gap CONSTANT in frames across the whole fight including reload windows (red under shot-coupled triggers — gaps would stretch around her 133-frame reloads), rangeApplied false on every instance.
spec.inertness: Proc count must not change when her fire cadence changes (e.g. under a fire-rate buff) — wall-clock interval.

spec.scope: Burst-skill damage bucket; crits at sheet rate, no core, no range.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast. Rule 9: burst-cast instant damage is FB-EXEMPT — the cast lands before the FB window opens, so no +50% FB major.
spec.nearestWrongModel: FB major applied to the burst hit (fbMajorApplied true) because 'bursts happen at FB time'.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: The mult-149.85 damage event on each isabel burstCast has fbMajorApplied false (and rangeApplied false). Red if the +50% major is credited.
spec.inertness: Fires only on isabel's own casts — zero instances on helm's burst rotations.

spec.scope: Boss DEBUFF (taxonomy #4: 'Damage Taken ▲' benefits the WHOLE TEAM's damage, incl. helm/liter/crown), not a self or ally buff.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec:5 — a short window opening right as/before FB, so which hits land inside it is timing-sensitive.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast, escalating stage 1 keyed to the same Marked Target counter as skill1. Stage is read POST-increment: her FIRST burst applies Marked Target 1, so this debuff fires from cast 1 (and, cumulatively, on every later cast).
spec.targetSet: enemy (boss-held debuff: buffApply with casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null; filter by stat+value).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoded as a self/allies damage buff instead of a boss debuff — or stage read PRE-increment so the first burst applies nothing (off-by-one: MT1 effect only from her 2nd cast).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: On isabel's FIRST burstCast: buffApply{stat:'damageTakenPct', value:39.96, casterIdx:null, targetIdx:null} appears, expiring ≈5×60 frames later; team members' damage inside that window reflects it. Red under off-by-one (absent on cast 1) and under self-buff encoding (targetIdx===isabel).
spec.inertness: Never applied on helm's burst rotations; never targets an ally slot.

spec.scope: Additional flat damage rider on the burst (flatDamage 299.7%); crit yes, core no, range no; FB-exempt like the main burst hit (same cast timing).
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast, escalating stage 2 — fires on her 2nd AND every subsequent cast ('each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it').
spec.nearestWrongModel: Stage effects read as exclusive tiers — at stage 3 only the 349.65% fires and the 299.7% stops.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Cast 2: 149.85 + 299.7 damage events (+DT debuff). Cast 3: 149.85 AND 299.7 AND 349.65 ALL present in the same cast frame-window. Red under highest-only (no 299.7 event on cast 3).
spec.inertness: No 299.7 event on her 1st cast or on helm's casts.

spec.scope: Second additional flat rider; same flags as MT2 (crit yes / core no / no range / FB-exempt).
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast, escalating stage 3 — from her 3rd cast onward, ON TOP of MT1+MT2 (total additional = 649.35% at stage 3, plus the 39.96% debuff).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Applied cumulatively with wrong sum (only 349.65 as the total 'additional'), or fired from cast 1 (stage counter shared with an over-firing fullBurstEnter model).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Per-cast burst-slot damage totals scale as ~149.85 / ~449.55 / ~799.2 (%ATK, pre-buckets) across casts 1/2/3. Red under exclusive-tier (cast 3 sums to ~499.5) and under FB-enter escalation (stage 3 reached on the 3rd TEAM FB rather than her 3rd cast).
spec.inertness: Zero 349.65 events before her 3rd own cast.

spec.kitLine: All allies: Full Burst Duration ▼ 5 sec
spec.scope: Team-wide Full Burst WINDOW modifier — this is the ▼ direction: it SHORTENS the FB window on her rotations from 10s to ~5s. It is emphatically NOT defensive/inert: it cuts the whole team's +50%-major uptime and FB-gated blocks roughly in half on her rotations. Model as fullBurstExtend seconds:-5 (or engine equivalent).
spec.durationSemantics: Applies to the FB window her cast opens (the rotation she bursts); helm's rotations keep the full 10s.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast — a property of the FB her cast initiates, not a global passive.
spec.targetSet: allies (collapses to the shared FB window; 'all allies' = everyone's FB state).
spec.nearestWrongModel: The classic miss: dropped as 'defensive, no damage' (or sign-flipped to +5s). A driver anchored on carry-positive kits will resist encoding a self-team NERF.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: On rotations where isabel cast: fullBurstEnd − fullBurstStart ≈ 5s (~300 frames); on helm-only rotations ≈ 10s (~600 frames). Team total damage in isabel-FB windows is materially below helm-FB windows, all else equal. Red under dropped (all FBs 10s) and under sign-flip (isabel FBs 15s).
spec.inertness: Helm's rotations must remain exactly 10s; FB cadence/rotation count itself unchanged (duration, not cooldown).

loadBearingSet: skill2:170.58% interval damage (⚑ cadence, single boss hit)
notes: Expected shared-prior misreads to reconcile, in priority order: (1) 'Full Burst Duration ▼ 5 sec' is the single most droppable line — it is a TEAM NERF that halves FB uptime on her rotations and must be modeled with negative sign; any test file lacking an FB-window-length assertion has not covered it. (2) burstCast vs fullBurstEnter is live in this exact fixture because controlComp defaults helm as co-B3: every Marked-Target counter and every stage effect must key to ISABEL's casts only — a fullBurstEnter model escalates twice as fast and applies S1 buffs on helm's rotations. (3) Escalation is CUMULATIVE ('each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it') on BOTH skill1 and burst — stage 3 fires 299.7 AND 349.65 plus the debuff; exclusive-tier encoding undercounts. Verify skill1 and burst share ONE stage counter (a single escalating counter or synced escalating blocks — they advance together on the same cast). (4) Stage read is post-increment: MT1 effects fire on her FIRST burst; assert presence on cast 1 to kill the off-by-one. (5) skill2's cadence is an ALWAYS-⚑ invented-trigger field (interval, sec not in prose — estimate from datamined skillCooldownsSec, verify by popup cadence); its 5-target clause collapses to ONE hit on the partless single boss (assert not ×5). (6) 'Damage Taken ▲' is a boss-held debuff (casterIdx/targetIdx null in buffApply) benefiting all four units — not a self buff. (7) 45s S1 durations vs 40s cd: uptime is near-permanent only if she bursts every rotation; in the co-B3 fixture her cast cadence depends on rotation alternation — assertions should count casts from the event log, never assume one per FB.
